docs: Read-only: returns the exact collateral/debt share deltas a real operate
would produce for the given (signed) token amounts, via `return_data`.
Mutates nothing; meant to be run through `simulateTransaction` so an SDK
can attach the correct vault tick / branch accounts. See `preview.rs`.

types.name: Dex
docs: Core DEX pool state. One per trading pair.
Uses zero_copy for efficient access without deserialization overhead.

types.name: DexAdmin
docs: DEX factory/admin account.

fields.name: guardians
docs: Guardians can pause a dex; unpause remains auth-only.

types.name: DexPosition
docs: Per-protocol per-DEX position.
Seeds: [DEX_POSITION_SEED, dex.key(), protocol.key()]

fields.name: center_price
docs: Initial center price: a normalized ratio scaled by PRICE_PRECISION (10^15)

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in 4 decimals: 1% = 10000, max 10% = 100000

fields.name: revenue_cut
docs: Revenue cut in 4 decimals (e.g., 100000 = 10%). Divided by 10000 for storage.

fields.name: upper_percent
docs: Upper range percent in 4 decimals: 1% = 10000

fields.name: lower_percent
docs: Lower range percent in 4 decimals: 1% = 10000

fields.name: upper_shift_threshold
docs: Upper shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

fields.name: lower_shift_threshold
docs: Lower shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

fields.name: threshold_shift_time
docs: Time (seconds) for threshold-based center price shift

fields.name: max_center_price
docs: Maximum center price

fields.name: min_center_price
docs: Minimum center price

fields.name: swap_0_to_1
docs: `true` = token0 in / token1 out; `false` = token1 in / token0 out.

fields.name: maker
docs: Signer that paid the input tokens — GeckoTerminal's `maker`.

fields.name: to
docs: Account that received the output tokens.

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Total input transferred by `maker`, fee inclusive.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Total output sent to `to`.

fields.name: fee_amount_in
docs: Swap fee charged on the input token: a subset of `amount_in`, inclusive of
the protocol revenue cut. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: reserves_token_0
docs: Pooled token0 after this swap — smart-collateral real reserves plus
smart-debt real reserves. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: reserves_token_1
docs: Pooled token1 after this swap. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: pool_price
docs: Post-swap pool (marginal) price, token1 per token0, 1e15 scale. This is NOT
the execution price of this swap (`amount_out / amount_in`): it is the ratio
of the post-swap imaginary reserves on whichever leg routed the larger
amount, so it excludes the swap fee and the slippage this swap paid.
Reserves are normalized to 9 decimals internally, so `pool_price / 1e15` is
already the whole-token price of token0 in token1 — no further decimal
adjustment is needed.
